byte_identity.what: the 95 documents converted with the base tree 71558af and with this branch, raw and gdocs profiles; word/*.xml compared part by part (exactdoc/ has no diff)

control_reproduced.how: lanes with a WP29 re-score: control equal to it field by field (control_vs_wp29_mismatches); round-4 lanes and gate batches were recorded under WP29's reading: control equal to the recorded row ('before')

findings.gate_05_memo_raw: within2pt 0.1205 -> 0.0602 against the committed baseline (tolerance 0.05): 10 of 83 matched words within 2pt at the box top, 5 at the baseline. Leaving: a dash, 'August' twice and two bullets, at baseline dy -2.05 and -3.55pt (render above source); their box-top dy was -0.26 and -1.51 because Helvetica's box top is 1.075 em above its baseline and Liberation Sans' 0.905.
findings.gdocs_profile: WP24's Docs placement model reads at the baseline: r4 Docs live y01 within-2pt 0.284 -> 0.694, 04 0.053 -> 0.565, r1 0.467 -> 0.939.
findings.live_text_docs_lane: the gdocs-profile DOCX writes contents leaders as dots, so x02's Docs-lane live text was already 0.974; dropping the matched dots from both sides reads 0.9715 (the remaining misses weigh more).
findings.product_refine_anchor: exactdoc/refine.py measures with ANCHOR = ANCHOR_TOP; its comment records that the baseline anchor lowered mean within-2pt 0.511 -> 0.478 -- measured by the box-top harness. At the baseline the product DOCX of Word-produced sources sits ~1.7pt high where the raw DOCX does not: y01 LO raw dy_p50 0.34pt, product 1.74pt (r4-new); y30 raw within-2pt 0.654, product 0.282. A conversion-code question for a later work package.

validation_ink.what: Independent check of the anchor on the checkpoint's LibreOffice product renders: words of lowercase letters without descenders, boxes from the glyph outlines (PyMuPDF TEXT_ACCURATE_BBOXES), anchored at the ink bottom, paired as the harness pairs. Median |dy| in pt per reading.
validation_ink.y65_nrc_jasperreports: its embedded Arial's outline boxes are not computed by PyMuPDF (ink bottom read 2.24pt below the origin); rasterising 'Title' at 20x puts the ink bottom 0.15pt below the origin in the source and 0.10pt in the render, so the baseline is the ink there too

what: Saved renders re-read by the amended harness with testkit/rescore.py: nothing converted or rendered again. within-2pt, dy_p50 and dy_p90 are measured at the text baseline (glyph origins) instead of the word box top; live_text_cov reads leaders and symbol-font PUA as page_words does, re-read from each kept DOCX. 'control' is the reading in force before (WP29's: box tops, live text raw), recomputed here from the same extraction; 'after' is the amended reading. Where a WP29 re-score of the same renders exists, the control was checked against it row by row ('control_vs_wp29_mismatches').
